summary.text: Joseph Gullett is a Republican state representative who has represented Georgia House District 19 since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Cynthia Starke-Jones.
A technology professional, he is a former chairman of the Paulding County GOP.

paragraphs.text: Gullett was born in Gwinnett County, Georgia, and as of January 2020 lived in Dallas, Georgia.
He received a bachelor's degree from Columbus State University.
His career experience includes working as a technical professional, and he has served as chairman of the Paulding County GOP and on the board of directors of the Paulding County Boys & Girls Club.
Gullett defeated incumbent Paulette Rakestraw in the July 24, 2018 Republican primary runoff for House District 19 and won the 2018 general election over Alison Feliciano.
He took office on January 14, 2019, and defeated Feliciano again in the 2020 general election.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Banks and Banking, Governmental Affairs, Insurance, Judiciary Juvenile, Judiciary - Non-Civil, and Technology and Infrastructure Innovation committees.
